excavation_context.character_description: Adult female grad student, long blonde hair, tanned skin, wearing a white sun hat, light pink blouse under a khaki safari vest, and white shorts.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_1 is working in an open-pit marsh quarry, using a trowel to clear a block of dark woody brown lignite matrix. Embedded inside the flaky, carbonized plant layer is the broad duck-billed snout of an Edmontosaurus skull. Soft overcast forest daylight casting realistic shadows across the crumbly organic matrix surface. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
